messages: Marta: Quick challenge for the commute crew
Marta: Quick challenge for the commute crew — share a microfiction (3	6 lines) + one track you'd listen to while reading it. Keep it commuter-friendly.
Ibrahim: 'She kept the map in her pocket even though the city had changed.'		Track: Tom Waits 'Innocent When You Dream' :violin:
rachel: 'He answered, 'No,' then smiled like it was the right lie.'		Track: Sharon Van Etten 'Seventeen'
sara: tiny one: 'There was a ticket. No name. She folded it into a paper plane.'	Track: Beach House 'Myth' :sunglasses:
Ibrahim: also, public-service PSA: headphones on trains, people :ear:
Marta: @playlists-bot can you throw these into a 15-min mix?
playlists-bot: Created 'Microfictions x Shortlist' https://open.spotify.com/playlist/5yExample (4 tracks added)
rachel: love this. anyone want to add a silly one? 3 lines & the dumbest song that would still make sense?
sara: 'Found a note: 'Don't forget the plant.' It was summer. The plant was fine.'	Track: 'Africa' by Toto (for maximum bus singalong) :laughing:
Marta: Voting time: react with :heart: on the pairing you'd actually read on a rainy commute.
Ibrahim: I'll annotate these in the retro doc later. Thanks for the tiny break, team :coffee:
